baseline_model: 65 percent previous season carryover + independently linked roster and scoring quality

limitations: Archived roster membership may reflect end-of-season players instead of actual pre-opening-day rosters
2026 was inspected in earlier experiments, so not pristine prospective validation
Grid is bounded; optimum may lie beyond candidate coefficients
No verified coaching change, recruit projection or true game venue

model_risks: Expanded all-coefficient winner hits quality grid ceiling at 1600
Shooting effect can double-count existing scoring quality
Current source team rosters lack opening-day historical timestamp verification
Defense approximated by steals and blocks; missing validated rebounding and possession data
conclusion: Selected baseline is best of the three retrospective tests on identical games. Challenger files are available and pass identity/arithmetic checks but cannot be promoted without full comparable historical validation.
